channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: The Marina Safeway may be SF NIMBYs’ last stand
item.description: A proposal to build a 25-story apartment complex above a grocery store shows that housing politics in San Francisco have fundamentally changed.

item.title: The Warriors win ugly against Memphis, but the All-Star break can’t come soon enough
item.description: After an emotional, injury-riddled couple of weeks, Golden State’s players and coaches are ready for a vacation.

item.title: He spent 25 years as a Giants exec. Now he’ll run the Oakland Ballers
item.description: Yeshayah Goldfarb was a trusted member of front offices led by Brian Sabean, Bobby Evans, and Farhan Zaidi.

item.title: Epstein fallout: VC Masha Bucher breaks her silence after revelations
item.description: The Day One Ventures founder, who acted as Jeffrey Epstein’s publicist for two years, said she turned to him amid “constant threats and scrutiny” from Russia.

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: Assessing the Warriors’ post-deadline outlook
item.description: Golden State traded Jonathan Kuminga, Buddy Hield, and Trayce Jackson-Davis and added Kristaps Porzingis.

item.title: PST: The SF teachers strike + governor candidate Matt Mahan
item.description: Plus, host Emily Dreyfuss’ kids drop by the office to explain what they’re doing now that school’s cancelled.

item.title: Inside Tony Vitello’s first day managing the Giants: ‘This is my guy’
item.description: The former college coach jumped into spring training with a rambling speech that made a strong impression on Buster Posey.

item.title: ‘Crocodile tears:’ SFUSD strike gets personal as schools chief ridiculed by teachers
item.description: Superintendent Maria Su is being lambasted for her leadership, her tears, her contract, and her choice in shoes.

item.title: The real reason for SFUSD’s strike
item.description: The district can’t pay its teachers because it’s buried under retirement costs that were predictable, avoidable, and arguably unconstitutional.

item.title: Teachers union files for Thursday afternoon ‘strike rally’ permit
item.description: As of Tuesday night, the school district and union are in negotiations that have dragged on since last March.
